about: The Municipal District of Bonnyville No. 87 surrounds the separate Town of Bonnyville and City of Cold Lake in northeastern Alberta’s lakeland—not those urban centres alone. Hamlets, farms, oilfield acreages, and lakes such as Moose and Muriel share a vast rural territory. About 13,000 people live in Bonnyville No. 87.
